thread:
Asha (Sec): Security advisory: developer SSH key policy update. We are retiring unmanaged long-lived SSH keys used for git/infra access. Requirement: rotate to short-lived SSH certs issued by our CA or enroll keys in company escrow. Deadline: 2026-07-01. Read below and act.
Raj (DevTools): Scope: does this affect deploy keys and CI SSH keys?
Asha (Sec): Yes. Human keys + deploy keys used for interactive access must use SSH certs. CI/deploy machines should use ephemeral machine identities (Vault-issued certs or service accounts). Exceptions require explicit approval in SEC-4999.
Mei (Platform): Quick migration steps added to docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/ssh-cert-migration. Summary: 1) install ca-client, 2) request cert: `ca-client request --principal alice@redwood --ttl 8h`, 3) configure ssh config to use CertFile, 4) remove private keys from local repo/storage.
Claire (Eng): Example ssh config snippet?
Raj (DevTools): Paste:
```
Host git.redwood.internal
  HostName git.redwood.internal
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519-cert.pub
  CertificateFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519-cert.pub
  IdentitiesOnly yes
```
Claire (Eng): Nice. How do we prove migration for a repo owner?
Asha (Sec): Evidence: paste `ssh -v git@git.redwood.internal` output showing certificate auth + CA fingerprint into SEC-4999. For deploy keys, paste pipeline logs showing ca-client token issuance or Vault cert retrieval.
infra-oncall: If multiple teams rotate at once, will we hit CA rate limits?
Raj (DevTools): We'll raise CA quota and baked-in rate limiting in ca-client. If you expect bulk churn, open a pre-warm ticket in SEC-4999 with estimated counts.
sec-bot: Automated scan enabled: weekly repo key inventory and cert-usage report. Initial inventory shows ~360 SSH public keys in git metadata and ~78 deploy keys. Results will post to SEC-4999.
Asha (Sec): Action items: 1) owners rotate interactive keys to SSH certs or enroll in escrow by 2026-07-01. 2) update CI/deploy systems to use Vault-issued short-lived certs. 3) remove any private keys stored in repos or shared drives and record remediation in SEC-4999. 4) request exceptions with justification.
Mei (Platform): I'll add a git hook to detect private key files in PRs and a pre-merge check to block accidental commits.
Claire (Eng): What's the emergency rollback if cert issuance breaks access?
Asha (Sec): Emergency flow: infra-oncall can issue a one-time emergency cert with approval, logged by sec-bot. Use only for <2h windows and then rotate. Abuse will trigger review.
Raj (DevTools): I'll ship a CLI helper and a Jenkins pipeline step template for cert issuance this sprint. PR -> infra/tools.
Asha (Sec): Thanks. Office hours Thursday 2pm PT for migrations. Noncompliance after 2026-07-01 will trigger automated key revocation and manual review. Ping me or open SEC-4999 for questions. :lock:
